description: Removes an existing subscription to SCP (local) Domain Information Change by DELETE on the individual subscription URI received in the Location header of the successful subscription response.
normative_statements: The Service Consumer shall send a DELETE request to the resource URI representing the individual subscription.
The request body shall be empty.
On success, the NRF shall return 204 No Content.
The response body shall be empty.
On failure, the NRF shall return a 4xx or 5xx response.
On failure, the response body may contain a ProblemDetails object describing the detailed information of the failure.
